content: Allow room owners and room managers to create external links to private rooms and to their files and folders. When this setting is off, existing links stop working until it is turned on again.

comment.text: Description under the toggle that allows external links of private (end-to-end encrypted) rooms, on the Security > External sharing page of the portal settings. Says who may create such links (room owners and room managers, the room roles) and that turning the setting off suspends existing links without deleting them. Two full sentences with periods.
